address: 183/8 Maharat Road, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30000, Thailand
bio: Chef-owner Anuwat Thiemkreangkrai's 12-year-old stall stands out with its fresh, light MSG-free seafood dishes. His passion shines through in stir-fries that bring out the natural essence of the fresh catch, such as celery with seabass and the beautifully balanced seafood with Thai basil....
